## Lessons

1. **The Sky Economy** (2:14) — Defines LAE and introduces delivery drones, electric air taxis, and other low-altitude uses. [Watch Lesson 1](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1RBcnocVRxs).
2. **Drone Tech** (2:26) — Compares drone designs and explains lift, sensors, professional uses, and current limits. [Watch Lesson 2](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Wma4RnkCGU4).
3. **Flying Taxi** (2:06) — Explains electric vertical-take-off aircraft, possible services, and barriers such as batteries, landing sites, and regulation. [Watch Lesson 3](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S1cFRO2l8PY).
4. **Smart Skyports** (2:02) — Shows the landing pads, terminals, charging, maintenance, and digital links a vertiport would need. [Watch Lesson 4](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=X4J0E0pIDIo).
5. **Air Traffic AI** (2:07) — Introduces unmanned traffic management: planning routes, detecting conflicts, responding to weather, and coordinating with conventional air traffic control. [Watch Lesson 5](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gxgC5Qk9u_A).
6. **Safe Skies** (2:23) — Discusses the safety rules behind operations, including registration, approved flight areas, insurance, and flights beyond visual line of sight. [Watch Lesson 6](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1ZudeJtICh4).
7. **Delivery** (2:05) — Follows a drone delivery from a hub to a landing point and considers payload, range, time, and regional trials. [Watch Lesson 7](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gO81rYGc3Zo).
8. **Rescue** (2:06) — Explores emergency medical delivery and the use of thermal imaging for searches, fires, and floods. [Watch Lesson 8](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cqihjaEHSWY).
9. **New Horizon** (2:17) — Surveys uses beyond delivery: precision agriculture, infrastructure inspection, and aerial tourism. [Watch Lesson 9](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9UXioQYRTb0).
10. **Sky Revolution** (2:20) — Pulls together market projections, the Greater Bay Area ecosystem, and careers in engineering, operations, AI, and policy. [Watch Lesson 10](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1hKZKD4pgEg).

## How to use these

- Watch Lessons 1–10 in order after the seven Orient reading pages.
- Programme facts and dated evidence stay on [Official status](tracker.qmd) and the Updates pages — not in these videos.

**Orient complete. Next:** [Week 1](week-01.qmd).
